title: Easy · My cat
text: My cat is called Biscuit. She is orange and very fluffy. Every morning she sits by the window and watches the birds. When I come home, she runs to the door and waits for her dinner.

title: Medium · The night market
text: On Friday evenings the night market fills with the smell of grilled corn and sweet potato. Families walk slowly between the stalls, and children beg their parents for bubble tea. My grandmother always buys the same thing: a small bag of roasted chestnuts, still warm from the pan.
